title: Swim Shorts with Funny Print – Butt on the Back
descriptionHtml:
The beach has seen the same shorts for twenty years

Navy, black, a discreet palm leaf. And the guy who "doesn't need anything" for a gift already has everything – except something that makes the whole group laugh.

The shorts that look like they've slipped down at the back

From the front: colorful swim shorts with a print and drawstring. From behind: the waistband looks like it has slipped down – the butt is part of the print, and the first reaction is always the same. The print lies flat in the fabric, so they feel like regular swim shorts to wear.

Features

  • Makes the whole beach turn around – the back looks like a waistband that has slipped down
  • The gift he'll actually use – real swim shorts with a drawstring at the waist
  • The print is part of the fabric – flat print, no 3D surface that chafes
  • Four designs to choose from – sharks, cocktail, crabs or Hawaiian flowers

Change your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
